name: The Thaw
description: Set in Szczecin, Poland, the series begins after the body of a young woman is discovered under the melting ice. It asks ‘Who was she? Why did she die? Who did she leave behind?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Still reeling from her husband’s death, Detective Katarzyna Zawieja launches an investigation into a murder of a young woman and her missing newborn.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Zawieja investigates the links between the murder and the suspicious debts and business dealings of the victim’s husband Kosiński.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As Zawieja and Trepa search for links between the victim and former patients at a psychiatric hospital where she worked, Strzelecki receives a suspicious package.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As the police launch a search for Wróbel, one of the victim’s patients, Zawieja visits the prison where he once served time.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The day of Magda’s funeral leads Zawieja on a dangerous chase for her killer, but an interrogation with an inmate at Goleniów prison breeds new clues – and increased suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Strzelecki takes charge of the case, a dangerous trip to a remote island brings Zawieja closer than ever to the truth.

videos.title: Episode One
videos.overview: After encountering a suspicious shipping container, Katarzyna is tasked with bringing down a crime lord with ties to a notorious trafficking ring.

videos.title: Episode Two
videos.overview: After learning a dark truth about her late husband's undercover work, Zawieja makes a series of rash decisions that could jeopardize the case.

videos.title: Episode Three
videos.overview: As she loses herself in her work, Zawieja discovers another shocking connection between her past, Oliwier's murder and the trafficking ring.

videos.title: Episode Four
videos.overview: After a fire at the docks, Zawieja attempts to tie the Lanskis to Oliwier’s murder. An unexpected ally helps locate the missing shipping container.

videos.title: Episode Five
videos.overview: While reeling from a devastating loss, Zawieja vows to locate a trafficking victim’s missing daughter.

videos.title: Episode Six
videos.overview: After surviving a violent shootout, Zawieja faces an impossible choice when her own family is caught in the crosshairs.

videos.title: Episode One
videos.overview: Having been demoted to a beat cop, Katarzyna Zawieja investigates a spate of drug overdoses while balancing an increasingly chaotic home life.

videos.title: Episode Two
videos.overview: After the murder of a high-school teacher reveals a connection to the local drug trade, Zawieja and Trepa investigate possible leads.

videos.title: Episode Three
videos.overview: As tensions flare between Zawieja and Trepa, the investigation uncovers a possible gang war brewing between Nowak and Molski.

videos.title: Episode Four
videos.overview: While protesters take to the streets, Zawieja attempts to connect the dots tying Nowak to Molski…but learns a shocking truth about herself instead.

videos.title: Episode Five
videos.overview: As Nowak's men prepare for their biggest deal yet, Trepa leads the investigation – unaware that Zawieja is missing.

videos.title: Episode Six
videos.overview: As Zawieja faces off against Molski, an investigation brings corruption on the force to light, and Trepa learns a surprising truth.
